name: product-callouts
title: Product Callouts
description: A product in the centre with three or four thin leader lines drawing out from points on it to labels with short spec text, one after another, in a spec-sheet style. The product is a drawn tumbler or your own image; labels, specs and the points the lines start from come from one variable.
useWhen: Showing what a product is made of: material, size, weight, features.
A product with several small selling points that each need a pointer.
avoidWhen: Selling points that are not about a part of the product: use step-explainer or stat-trio.
More than four points: the labels crowd.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Subtitle
variables.description: One short line under the title.

variables.label: Callouts
variables.description: One per line, up to 4: Label|Spec|x|y. x and y (0 to 100) are where the line starts on the product box. Points left of the middle get their label on the left.
variables.default:
Tutup|Anti bocor|68|6
Bahan|Stainless 304|30|30
Kapasitas|500 ml|70|55
Berat|280 g|34|80

variables.label: Image
variables.description: Optional product image URL (a transparent PNG works best). Empty draws a tumbler.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: Dots at the points: the one accent.

variables.label: Text colour
variables.description: Title, specs, lines and the drawn product outline.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
